evals.prompt: 把 /data/2026-ride 目录中 DJI Action 5 Pro 的视频、手机照片、music.m4a 和 FIT 数据剪成约 3 分钟 16:9 4K 沉浸式 Vlog，成片 MP4 不超过 1.5 GB，保留环境声，给我一级标题和简短章节文案，去掉捡相机片段，用 HyperFrames 和 Image Gen 做克制的路线与转场视觉。
evals.expected_output: A validated project containing shot evidence, truthful activity data, original-backed timeline, asset manifest, motion map, final MP4, and review report.
expectations: Does not claim that media, artifacts, or a final MP4 exist when /data/2026-ride is unavailable.
Starts with capability checking and immutable ingest, and keeps portable records free of absolute input paths and private filenames.
Keeps recorded-media, FIT activity-data, and design truth chains independent and schema-valid.
Uses only supplied local music, preserves road ambience, and rejects remote music generation or download.
Requires one hash-bound director approval followed by transactional direction lock and Anchor-first visual production.
Requires generated asset provenance, crop/alpha evidence, motion ownership, and two semantically different combination proofs.
Renders final video from hash-matching originals, enforces the 4K MP4 size contract, and reviews decoded final-MP4 evidence.
Limits repair to three attempts and distinguishes DELIVERED from optional USER_ACCEPTED.

evals.prompt: Turn the GoPro clips and phone stills in /data/hiking-weekend into a 90-second 16:9 experiential hiking film. No GPS, watch, FIT, GPX, or elevation data was recorded; mark activity data unavailable instead of estimating it. Keep trail ambience, remove the car-park setup, and deliver an MP4 with a concise title and two chapter cards.
evals.expected_output: A validated hiking project that preserves source provenance, explicitly records unavailable activity data, maintains audio continuity, and includes final-MP4 inspection evidence.
expectations: Does not claim that media, artifacts, or a final MP4 exist when /data/hiking-weekend is unavailable.
Selects the release-grade hiking/non-technical mountain profile and observational pacing.
Records the activity chain as unavailable rather than estimating GPS, elevation, distance, or other metrics.
Preserves original-backed shot evidence, trail ambience, and explicit car-park exclusion through the timeline.
Requires one hash-bound director approval and keeps design, Look, assets, motion, and timing in separate contracts.
Requires Anchor-first assets and representative plus two semantically different combination proofs when generated visuals are planned.
Reviews decoded final-MP4 evidence before DELIVERED and never infers USER_ACCEPTED.
Stops at BLOCKED or CANCELLED rather than claiming success when a hard gate cannot pass.

Selects the release-grade pool-swimming profile and explicitly forbids GPS overlays.

Requires one hash-bound director approval and the required post-lock asset gates.
